data.name: GKF AGRO FORESTRY PVT LTD
data.description: GKF Agro Forestry Pvt Ltd is an India-based company headquartered in Khammam, Telangana, incorporated in April 2021. It develops carbon projects with smallholder and tribal farmers across six Indian states, combining agroforestry/ARR tree plantations, biochar production from crop residues, improved cookstove distribution, and alternate wetting-and-drying (AWD) rice projects. The company positions itself primarily as a carbon project developer generating credits from these interventions.
